applicants: Casting, Forging and Machining Cluster of South Africa NPC
ruling: NERSA ordered to redetermine 2024/25 electricity tariffs. Court declared NERSA approval unlawful and invalid.
implication_for_billdog: Ekurhuleni 2024/25 electricity tariffs are under legal redetermination. Return UNKNOWN for all 2024/25 Ekurhuleni electricity charge verifications. If overcharging occurred, customers may receive credits — note this in dispute documentation.
